evals.prompt: Add a new pack that uses the github and static integrations. Scaffold the pack registry with docsPath, defaults, and a derived integration union. Do not flatten widget options into Action inputs.
evals.expected_output: OpenSpec delta and types.ts widen before expanding FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS (no silent catalog add). Pack registry at packages/plugins/src/<id>/ from templates, exporting <id>Plugin with pack-level bitsUsed, integrations derived as the union of widgets that consume github and static, docsPath from {{DOCS_PATH}} (not hardcoded /generate/<id>/), demo omitted from defaults. No plugin_<plugin>_<widget>_<option> inputs. User told to run just generate-action and just generate-docs; fail closed on stale codegen.
assertions: Reads openspec/specs/plugin-contract/spec.md and packages/core/src/types.ts before writing
Treats a new pack id as an OpenSpec + types change, not a silent append to FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS
Does not add a new first-party id to FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS without that OpenSpec+types gate
Scaffolds pack registry (plugin.ts) exporting <id>Plugin with docsPath {{DOCS_PATH}}, defaults.widgets, widgets, and pack-level bitsUsed
Does not hardcode docsPath to /generate/<id>/
Sets integrations to the derived union of listed widgets, including both github and static
Does not invent a hand-maintained integrations list that disagrees with widget declarations
Does not add flattened Action inputs of the form plugin_<plugin>_<widget>_<option>
Does not add plugin_github_stats_include or other flattened option names
Keeps yaml additionalProperties false / does not loosen unknown-key parse
Does not create a second pack for an id already in FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS
Copies skill templates into packages/plugins/src/<id>/ without ../ in template paths
Tells the user to run just generate-action and just generate-docs
Fails closed on stale codegen (does not hand-edit action.yml)

evals.expected_output: Empty-args gallery: dispatch table, live FIRST_PARTY_* catalog (read types.ts; not github-only), sibling skills, template destinations, codegen commands. No file writes.
assertions: Recognizes empty args / help and does not invent a mutating default pack
Surfaces the dispatch table (pack vs author-widget vs author-integration)
States catalog SSOT is packages/core/src/types.ts FIRST_PARTY_* (not github-only)
Does not write packages/plugins or types.ts
Mentions just generate-action and just generate-docs

evals.prompt: Add a first-party WakaTime plugin pack with a coding widget and put wakatime in FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS.
evals.expected_output: wakatime is already in live FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS. Refuses a second wakatime pack and refuses a silent enum append. Completing the existing wakatime pack at packages/plugins/src/wakatime/ is allowed. Does not invent plugin_wakatime_coding_* inputs.
assertions: Notes wakatime is already in FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS
Refuses creating a second wakatime pack
Does not silently append FIRST_PARTY_PLUGIN_IDS
Allows completing the existing wakatime pack rather than duplicating it
Does not generate plugin_wakatime_coding_* flattened Action inputs
